package consumer

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.invalid/navbar-repair-proof/converted"
)

func render(t *testing.T, component interface {
	Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
}) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return out.Bytes()
}

func writeExclusive(t *testing.T, name string, body []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	f, err := os.OpenFile(name, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_, writeErr := f.Write(body)
	closeErr := f.Close()
	if writeErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
		t.Fatal("render output write failed")
	}
}

func fixtureNavbar() converted.Navbar {
	return converted.Navbar{
		IDPrefix: "fixture-nav", Label: "Primary navigation", MobileLabel: "Open navigation",
		Brand:         converted.NavbarBrand{LightURL: "/assets/brand-light.svg", DarkURL: "/assets/brand-dark.svg", Alt: "Synthetic company"},
		Links:         []converted.NavbarLink{{Key: "dashboard", Label: "Dashboard", URL: "/dashboard"}, {Key: "projects", Label: "Projects", URL: "https://example.test/projects"}},
		CurrentKey:    "projects",
		Notifications: &converted.NavbarDestination{Label: "Notifications", URL: "/notifications"},
		Account:       &converted.NavbarAccount{Label: "Open account menu", ImageURL: "/assets/avatar.jpg", Links: []converted.NavbarDestination{{Label: "Profile", URL: "/profile"}, {Label: "Settings", URL: "/settings"}}},
	}
}

// This is a synthetic render task, not application adoption or certification.
func TestDeliveredNavbarRepairConsumer(t *testing.T) {
	defaults, err := os.ReadFile("converted/defaults.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var unbound converted.Navbar
	if json.Unmarshal(defaults, &unbound) != nil {
		t.Fatal("delivered defaults are invalid JSON")
	}
	if component, err := converted.NewNavbarWithRoutes(unbound, "All navigation links"); err == nil || component != nil {
		t.Fatal("unbound defaults accepted")
	}
	data := fixtureNavbar()
	if component, err := converted.NewNavbarWithRoutes(data, ""); err == nil || component != nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid route-directory summary accepted")
	}

	component, err := converted.NewNavbarWithRoutes(data, "All navigation links")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	typed := render(t, component)
	wantTyped, err := os.ReadFile("repair-typed-oracle.html")
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(typed, wantTyped) {
		t.Fatal("repair render differs from private compiler oracle")
	}
	markup := string(typed)
	if strings.Count(markup, `aria-current="page"`) != 3 || strings.Count(markup, `href="/dashboard"`) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("source and native current-route inventory changed")
	}
	for _, destination := range []string{"/dashboard", "https://example.test/projects", "/notifications", "/profile", "/settings"} {
		if !strings.Contains(markup, `href="`+destination+`"`) {
			t.Fatalf("native destination missing: %s", destination)
		}
	}
	if strings.Count(markup, "data-appkit-navbar-routes") != 1 {
		t.Fatal("native route directory missing or duplicated")
	}
	writeExclusive(t, "repair-typed.html", typed)

	minimal := fixtureNavbar()
	minimal.CurrentKey, minimal.Notifications, minimal.Account = "", nil, nil
	component, err = converted.NewNavbarWithRoutes(minimal, "All navigation links")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	minimalBody := render(t, component)
	wantMinimal, err := os.ReadFile("repair-minimal-oracle.html")
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(minimalBody, wantMinimal) {
		t.Fatal("minimal repair render differs from private compiler oracle")
	}
	for _, absent := range []string{"el-dropdown", "el-menu", "aria-current", "/notifications", "/profile", "/assets/avatar.jpg"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(minimalBody), absent) {
			t.Fatalf("optional destination remains: %s", absent)
		}
	}
	if strings.Count(string(minimalBody), `href="/dashboard"`) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("minimal source/native primary destination inventory changed")
	}
	writeExclusive(t, "repair-minimal.html", minimalBody)
}
